paperTitleZh: 化學 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 甲部 工業化學
paperTitle: Chemistry Mock — Paper 2 Section A Industrial Chemistry

parts.label: a(i1)
parts.questionTextZh: 以氫氣為目標產物，通過比較原子經濟，推定哪個方法的原子經濟較高。
parts.questionTextEn: Taking hydrogen as the desired product, compare the atom economies of the two methods and deduce which is higher.

parts.label: a(i2)
parts.questionTextZh: 儘管如此，方法 2 仍被認為較「綠色」。舉出一個原因。
parts.questionTextEn: Even so, Method 2 is considered 'greener'. Give one reason.

parts.label: a(ii1)
parts.questionTextZh: 蒸汽重整的第一階段產物是合成氣。合成氣含有哪兩種主要氣體？
parts.questionTextEn: The first-stage product of steam reforming is syngas. What are the two main gases in syngas?

parts.label: a(ii2)
parts.questionTextZh: 寫出由甲烷和水蒸氣製造合成氣的化學方程式。
parts.questionTextEn: Write the chemical equation for making syngas from methane and steam.

parts.label: a(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 氯鹼工業也有氫氣生成。除氫氣外，寫出氯鹼工業的另一種產品。
parts.questionTextEn: Hydrogen is also formed in the chloroalkali industry. Apart from hydrogen, name one other product of the chloroalkali industry.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextEn: What is meant by the term 'activation energy'?

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 在下面的坐標軸上，繪出這正向反應的能線圖，並標示活化能和 $\Delta H$。
parts.questionTextEn: On the axes below, draw the energy profile of this forward reaction, and label the activation energy and $\Delta H$.

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 寫出甲醇合成的 $K_c$ 表達式，並說明溫度上升時 $K_c$ 怎樣改變。
parts.questionTextEn: Write the expression for $K_c$ of the synthesis of methanol, and state how $K_c$ changes when the temperature rises.

parts.label: b(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼工業上選用約 250 °C 和 70 atm。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why about 250 °C and 70 atm are chosen in industry.

parts.label: b(v)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼催化劑不會改變甲醇的平衡產率。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why the catalyst does not change the equilibrium yield of methanol.

parts.label: c(i1)
parts.questionTextZh: 寫出這過程的總反應方程式。
parts.questionTextEn: Write the overall equation of this process.

parts.label: c(i2)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼這過程只需少量的氯化銅(II)。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why only a small amount of copper(II) chloride is needed in this process.

parts.label: c(i3)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼可用水除去產物氣體中未反應的氯化氫。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why water can be used to remove unreacted hydrogen chloride from the product gases.

parts.label: c(ii1)
parts.questionTextZh:
某廠在恆溫下探究以下反應：
$\mathrm{2NO(g) + O_2(g) \rightarrow 2NO_2(g)}$
第 1 次：$[\mathrm{NO}]$ = 0.010 M，$[\mathrm{O_2}]$ = 0.010 M，初速 = $7.0\times10^{-6}\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}\ \text{s}^{-1}$
第 2 次：0.020 M，0.010 M，$2.8\times10^{-5}$
第 3 次：0.030 M，0.020 M，$1.26\times10^{-4}$
第 4 次：0.015 M，0.040 M，初速待求
推定對應 NO 和 $\mathrm{O_2}$ 的反應級數。
parts.questionTextEn:
A plant investigates the following reaction at constant temperature:
$\mathrm{2NO(g) + O_2(g) \rightarrow 2NO_2(g)}$
Trial 1: $[\mathrm{NO}]$ = 0.010 M, $[\mathrm{O_2}]$ = 0.010 M, initial rate = $7.0\times10^{-6}\ \text{mol dm}^{-3}\ \text{s}^{-1}$
Trial 2: 0.020 M, 0.010 M, $2.8\times10^{-5}$
Trial 3: 0.030 M, 0.020 M, $1.26\times10^{-4}$
Trial 4: 0.015 M, 0.040 M, initial rate to be found
Deduce the order of reaction with respect to NO and to $\mathrm{O_2}$.

parts.label: c(ii2)
parts.questionTextZh: 計算速率常數（須寫出單位），並預測第 4 次的初速。
parts.questionTextEn: Calculate the rate constant, stating its unit, and predict the initial rate in Trial 4.
